m01:room.title: The Signal Integrity Vault
m01:room.job: Settle whether the altitude step at the relay handoff came from the craft.

m02:room.title: The Kinematics Calibration Hall
m02:room.job: Work out which way Odyssey is moving at closest approach, and how fast.

m03:room.title: The Thruster Diagnostics Bay
m03:room.job: Settle whether a leaking valve is pushing Odyssey off its arc.

m04:room.title: The Impulse Reconstruction Lab
m04:room.job: Work out how much push the engine's test pulse actually delivered.

m05:room.title: The Propellant Systems Gallery
m05:room.job: Find where the reserve line's pressure settles once the valve is open.

m06:room.title: The Mass Flow Metrology Room
m06:room.job: Find out how much fuel the transfer actually put into the main tank.

m07:room.title: The Pressure Decay Observatory
m07:room.job: Forecast the cabin pressure across the whole coast from two gauge readings.

m08:room.title: The Thermal Control Workshop
m08:room.job: Work out when the frost will have taken half the star tracker window.

m09:room.title: The Route Survey Theater
m09:room.job: Find out whether one spool of cable reaches the rim mast along the planned route.

m10:room.title: The Polar Navigation Rotunda
m10:room.job: Find the heading of the ground track as it passes the relay mast.

m11:room.title: The Corridor Survey Chamber
m11:room.job: Settle whether the wider aim box still fits inside the safe corridor.

m12:room.title: The Series Accounting Annex
m12:room.job: Book the whole aim shift the string of corrections will produce.

m13:room.title: The Residual Analysis Atrium
m13:room.job: Fix the band of gimbal gains the correction series settles inside.

m14:room.title: The Verification Shield Room
m14:room.job: Fix the band of attitude angles the cubic sine model may be flown in.

m15:room.title: The Return Burn Control Room
m15:room.job: Set the command that puts Odyssey on the transfer arc home.
